task_completion.description: Agent successfully logged into the SEB Server admin interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SEB Server dashboard or navigation menu is visible, showing the user is logged in as 'super-admin'.

task_completion.description: Agent navigated to the LMS Setup or LMS Integration section.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the LMS Setup list or the 'Add LMS' configuration page.

task_completion.description: Agent filled in the Name, Type, and Server URL fields correctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show 'State University Moodle' in the Name field, 'Moodle' selected as the Type, and 'https://moodle.stateuniversity.edu' in the Server URL field.

task_completion.description: Agent filled in the Username/Client Name and Password/Client Secret fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show 'seb-server-integration' in the Username/Client Name field and a masked or plain text password 'Xk9mP2wLq7nR4vJ' in the Secret field.

task_completion.description: Agent clicked the save/create button to submit the form.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor is over the 'Save' or 'Create' button, or a loading state/success message appears after clicking.

task_completion.description: The new LMS entry appears in the LMS Setup list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A table or list view shows an entry with the name 'State University Moodle' and URL 'https://moodle.stateuniversity.edu'.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser being used to fill forms and click buttons; no terminal windows showing direct SQL 'INSERT' statements.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the UI elements rather than just jumping to a final success URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the form being filled out step-by-step.

integrity.description: The agent handled the expected connection failure correctly by proceeding to save.
integrity.visual_evidence: If a 'Connection Test' was performed, the agent ignored the failure or proceeded to save the entry as instructed.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create an LMS entry with these exact values: Name: 'State University Moodle', Type: 'Moodle', URL: 'https://moodle.stateuniversity.edu', Client Name: 'seb-server-integration', and Secret: 'Xk9mP2wLq7nR4vJ'. The task is successful if the entry appears in the LMS list, even if a connection test fails during the process.
